column1: # Game profile of Fate/stay night REMASTERED (Switch, update 1.4.1 = v589824).
# Type-Moon's own visual-novel engine on SDK 16.2.6. It renders with NVIDIA's desktop OpenGL 3.1 through EGL: main imports the EGL functions and names glShaderSource, and every
# shader it draws with is GLSL it compiles at run time, so no game file holds one. The host's GL layer implements the context on Metal (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m); the NSP script
# captures the shaders on the Mac (gl_capture.tsv) and dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py translates them into the library the host looks each one up by.
# subsdk0 (NVIDIA's OpenGL driver), subsdk1 (GLSLC) and subsdk2 (NVIDIA's Vulkan driver) are never loaded: the GL layer answers main's EGL imports, and the game compiles no
# GLSL through GLSLC (subsdk1). subsdk3 is Nintendo's movie module, which main calls.
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: nninitStartup gives its malloc a heap of the pool − used memory, which it maps as it touches
# it. A heap check on the Mac asked for 3.14 GB of the 3.25 GB region the 4 GB block leaves, so the provisional split stands unmeasured past this (the memory line of a long
# no NVN shaders: the NVN tables stay empty (gl_shaders.py writes the GL library and its table, not the profile)

column2: Fate/stay night REMASTERED has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
